parsed.answer: As of August 22, Ivo’s Cobalt project uses STREAM-1-286 delivery, and its retry policy is RETRY-1-907.

citations.quote: 2026-08-15. Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286.
The retry policy is now RETRY-1-907, superseding RETRY-1-108.
2026-08-22. Ivo reviewed Cobalt. Keep the August 15 delivery choice.
